name: Chart - Item
description: One column of the Score Distribution histogram. Result sets the colour (Marksman = info, Passed = success, Failed = danger, Empty = no trainees at that score). State=Dimmed is used when another result is selected in the Trainee Results tabs. The bar fills the column: set the instance height to (count ÷ y-axis max × 112) + 18 px.

name: Chart - Score Distribution
description: Score distribution histogram for Marksmanship training results. One bar per score 0–20, built from "Chart / Score Distribution Bar". Filter variant matches the selected Trainee Results tab: bars of other results switch to State=Dimmed. Threshold lines (Pass, Marksman) are placed for scores 12 and 19 and scale when the chart is resized; move them if the thresholds differ. Y-axis max is 4 in this example.
